tools.name: web.search
tools.purpose: Search a configured, user-authorized web search provider and return compact, source-identifiable results that can be fetched or cited in a task.

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Source records containing sourceID, title, URL, snippet, domain, and optional publication date

outputs.name: metadata
outputs.description: Provider, cache status, elapsed time, and query metadata

side_effects: Creates a local in-memory cache entry and an auditable tool event
dependencies: Configured Brave Search API or self-hosted SearxNG endpoint
security_requirements: Search results are read-only provenance records

tools.name: web.fetch
tools.purpose: Fetch a user-authorized or search-provenance URL, extract readable text, and return a bounded source record for evidence-backed task work.

inputs.name: sourceID
inputs.description: Optional source identifier returned by web.search

inputs.name: maxChars
inputs.description: Maximum extracted characters returned to the model

outputs.name: source
outputs.description: URL, title, domain, content type, sourceID, cache status, and fetch metadata

side_effects: Creates a local in-memory cache entry and an auditable tool event

examples.description: Fetch a source returned by search

security_requirements: Never expose authorization headers or secrets
